about_the_game:
Included in demo:
  • Multiplayer PvP
  • Ranked matchmaking
  • Tutorial and vs AI mode
  • Private games with friends and customizable settings
  • Leaderboard
  • Earnable coins and unlockable avatars and cosmetics
  • Campaign missions with rewards

All earned coins and unlocked content with transfer to the full game.

The full game will include new modes including multi-table tournaments (brawls), more social elements, cosmetics and more.

In Poker Warlords, each card dealt spawns a medieval fantasy army! You might get dealt a mighty 10 out of 10 Dragons or a measly 8 out of 40 Footmen. Play traditional poker betting rounds with face-down and face-up cards, then choose which two armies will fight for you in battle. You have to know when to hold 'em and when to fold 'em!

Each hand creates a new opportunity to flex your strategic muscle and gather all the chips into your stack. Raise, Call, or Fold on three-card hands of medieval fantasy armies, then choose two to fight for you in the arena. Wager on random numbers of Dragon and Dark Knights against Trebuchets and Assassins. Weigh the odds based on the type and number of units in hand against each opponent's visible card. Go all in or bluff to psych out the competition, or dominate with pure force to claim victory. Poker Warlords takes traditional poker strategy and layers it with a rich combat system, creating a new experience unlike any other.

Bet smart, battle hard, then win big! Choose your front line and back line cards then clash your armies in fast-paced autobattler combat. The last unit standing takes the pot.

Earn your place on the leaderboard or enjoy casual games with friends. Unlock rare avatars, customize your experience, and enter high-stakes competitions. Poker Warlords is free-to-play and features no pay-to-win mechanics—just skill, strategy, and style.

Built by the developers of BattlePoker, a top-10 StarCraft II arcade game, Poker Warlords brings a fresh, competitive twist to both poker and autobattlers. Years of refinement, an innovative blend of strategy, and a passionate community—this is poker like you’ve never played before.
